title: Assistance and camera package as standard on the flagship
statement: Adaptive cruise control with stop and go, surround view and front camera shall be standard on every G70, with following distance and lane keeping adjustable by one control.
rationale: Active cruise control is level A (23 rows), parking assistant (19) and surround view (7 wishes) add that owners expect these on a 100k car; adaptive driving assist (5.32 vs 5.77) and parking cameras (5.46 vs 5.80) score below the peer.
acceptance_criteria: US: Variants with ACC stop and go and surround view as standard All (evidence) | US: Study parking cameras and sensors (1-7) >= 5.8 (today 5.46) (evidence)

title: Fully customisable personal drive mode
statement: The personal mode shall let the driver combine suspension, steering, throttle, sound and energy settings, start in the last chosen mode and hide modes that are not used.
rationale: My Modes is level A (31 rows, 14 wishes) and linked to the study attribute customisation ease (4.34 vs peer 5.20).
acceptance_criteria: US: Study customisation ease (1-7) >= 5.2 (today 4.34, peer 5.20) (evidence) | US: Mode kept after ignition off Last mode per profile (evidence)

title: Headlights that light the road like a flagship
statement: The headlights shall offer strong low-beam reach and selective high-beam masking in the US as allowed by regulation, and lighting faults shall not occur in the first year.
rationale: Exterior lighting is level A (24 rows, 10 defects) and supported by headlight performance (5.55 vs 5.93); owners note that US cars lack the selective beam available elsewhere.
horizon_rationale: Software activation where the hardware allows; fault fixes in production.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study headlight performance (1-7) >= 5.9 (today 5.55, peer 5.93) (evidence) | US: Adaptive driving beam Activated in the US where legally permitted (assumption)
uncertainties: Depends on the US adaptive driving beam regulation as applied to the current hardware.

title: Personal onboarding for flagship owners
statement: Every owner shall be offered a personal introduction (at delivery and again after four weeks) plus an in-car guided tour and a searchable model-specific manual.
rationale: The largest complaint cluster (89 rows, level A) is about complexity; owner's manual (22 rows) and general enquiries (21 rows) ask for more guidance after delivery.
acceptance_criteria: US: Owners offered a follow-up introduction after four weeks 100 % (assumption) | US: Complaint rows about complexity -30 % within 12 months (assumption)

title: Climate system that cools a large cabin fast and lets passengers direct the air
statement: The climate system shall cool the cabin quickly after sun soak, let front and rear occupants direct the airflow, and offer temperature and fan controls that do not require menus.
rationale: Vehicle climatisation (42 rows), blower (23) and air conditioning (20) are all level A; the study puts air conditioning performance at 4.48 vs peer 5.19 and climate control at 4.74 vs 5.14. Owners in hot states describe the car as undriveable for minutes after parking.
horizon_rationale: Vent design and blower calibration in the life-cycle impulse; controls in software.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study air conditioning performance (1-7) >= 5.2 (today 4.48, peer 5.19) (evidence) | US: Cabin cool-down from 60 °C soak to 25 °C <= 10 min (to be validated) (assumption) | US: Adjustable airflow direction at front vents Yes (evidence)

title: Intuitive controls for a flagship driver
statement: The frequently used functions (climate, seat functions, drive mode, start-stop, assistance, audio source and volume, navigation zoom) shall be operable with one touch, a physical control or a reliable voice command, without searching through apps.
rationale: The operating concept is the largest digital complaint (66 rows, 62 usability, level A) and the study puts controls intuitiveness at 4.36 vs peer 5.20 and controls usability at 4.51 vs 5.12; touch screen complaints (39 rows, level A) say the same.
horizon_rationale: Software layer and shortcut concept; physical controls in the life-cycle impulse.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study controls intuitiveness (1-7) >= 5.2 (today 4.36, peer 5.20) (evidence) | US: Study controls usability (1-7) >= 5.1 (today 4.51) (evidence) | US: Touches for the listed functions while driving <= 1 (assumption)

title: In-car connectivity that stays connected
statement: The personal eSIM, Wi-Fi hotspot and connected services shall activate once and stay working with all major US carriers, including business plans, without repeated resets.
rationale: Personal eSIM is a large complaint cluster (42 rows, 14 defects) and connected drive / infotainment technology is level A (39 rows, 24 defects); Wi-Fi hotspot (4.51 vs 4.98) and connected services (4.83 vs 5.13) score below the peer. The rear theatre screen depends on it.
acceptance_criteria: US: eSIM activation success on first attempt >= 98 % across the four largest US carriers (assumption) | US: Study Wi-Fi hotspot (1-7) >= 5.0 (today 4.51, peer 4.98) (evidence)
uncertainties: Carrier-side provisioning is partly outside BMW's control.

title: Seamless smartphone integration and audio worthy of the flagship
statement: Apple CarPlay and Bluetooth shall pair once, connect to the active driver's phone and play at the same loudness as native sources; the premium audio systems shall deliver the bass and clarity customers expect at this price.
rationale: Apple CarPlay (28 rows, level A) and pairing (16 rows) complaints match the study gaps in smartphone integration (4.79 vs 5.49) and phone pairing (5.03 vs 5.59); audio is level A (27 rows) with bass 4.97 vs 5.59 and clarity 5.06 vs 5.68.
horizon_rationale: Software, tuning and speaker placement within the life-cycle impulse.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study smartphone integration (1-7) >= 5.5 (today 4.79, peer 5.49) (evidence) | US: Study audio bass (1-7) >= 5.6 (today 4.97, peer 5.59) (evidence) | US: CarPlay audio level vs native sources Within 3 dB at the same volume step (assumption)

title: Navigation and voice assistant that get it right the first time
statement: Route guidance shall give lane advice early and clearly on multi-lane highways, and the voice assistant shall understand natural phrasing of common commands without exact wording.
rationale: Navigation is level A (28 rows) with the study at 4.85 vs peer 5.53; the personal assistant is level A (23 rows) linked to voice recognition (4.76 vs 4.99).
acceptance_criteria: US: Study navigation (1-7) >= 5.5 (today 4.85, peer 5.53) (evidence) | US: Voice command success on a 50-command natural-language test set >= 90 % (assumption)

title: Electric range that matches the flagship's long-distance role
statement: The successor of the i7 shall offer a real-world range that covers long US highway stages in cold weather without range anxiety.
rationale: Electric range is level A (45 rows, 17 wishes for 350 to 400 miles); winter range below 150 miles is reported, and fuel economy scores 4.99 vs 5.48.
acceptance_criteria: US: EPA range of the BEV >= 350 mi (assumption) | US: Range at -7 °C >= 75 % of EPA range (assumption)

title: Fault-free first months of ownership
statement: A new car shall reach the customer free of drivetrain, electrical and paint faults; repairs in the first three months shall be the exception, not the experience.
rationale: Drivetrain complaints (51 rows, 27 defects) and exterior complaints (43 rows, 27 defects: paint, trim) report breakdowns, warnings and long workshop stays in the first weeks; reliability (5.52 vs 5.92) and electrical reliability (5.18 vs 5.42) are below the peer.
horizon_rationale: Launch quality measures in production and pre-delivery inspection.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study reliability (1-7) >= 5.9 (today 5.52, peer 5.92) (evidence) | US: Workshop visits for faults in the first 90 days -50 % vs current model year (assumption)

title: Confident braking, including under assisted driving
statement: The brakes shall feel strong and progressive at highway speeds, and assisted driving shall slow down early and smoothly for slower traffic instead of braking late and hard.
rationale: Braking draws 33 complaint rows with 10 defects (weak stopping above 60 mph, late harsh braking in cruise); adaptive driving assist scores 5.32 vs 5.77.
horizon_rationale: Brake system calibration and assistance software.
acceptance_criteria: US: Braking complaint rows <= 12 per 6 months (today 33) (assumption) | US: Peak deceleration of ACC when approaching slower traffic <= 3 m/s² outside emergencies (assumption)

title: Calmer front design (split grille, smaller black areas)
statement: Redesign the front with a less dominant grille and less black surface.
rationale: The grille draws 10 complaint rows and 18 design wishes, but exterior design is the strongest praise theme of the car (210 likes). The criticism is real but polarising; a redesign risks the main reason buyers chose the car. Kept visible for the PM's decision.
horizon_rationale: Front-end design change belongs to the successor or the next life-cycle impulse.

title: Automatic doors that never open unintentionally while driving
statement: The electric doors shall not open from an inside button while the car is moving or a gear is engaged, shall start moving within an agreed delay, and shall close reliably from outside with a clearly placed button.
rationale: Automatic doors draw 40 complaint rows (9 defects, 30 usability) next to 45 likes. Several owners report that a knee touches the inside button and the door opens while driving: a safety risk on a flagship feature.
horizon_rationale: Interlock logic is software; button guard or relocation fits the life-cycle impulse.
acceptance_criteria: US: Door opening from inside button above walking speed or in gear Not possible (evidence) | US: Delay from button press to door movement <= 0.5 s (assumption) | US: Automatic door defect rows 0 in the next feedback wave (assumption)

title: Robust glass roof with an opening option and blinds that work
statement: The panoramic glass roof shall not crack in normal use, shall limit heat entry, and an opening sunroof shall be offered; the rear and side blinds shall operate by button and not get stuck.
rationale: The panorama glass roof draws 38 complaint rows with 14 defects (cracks, bubbles) and 17 wishes for an opening roof; sun protection adds 27 rows (blinds stuck, operated only via the screen).
horizon_rationale: An opening roof needs a body-in-white change; glass quality and blind fixes start in H1 but the full requirement lands with the successor.
acceptance_criteria: US: Roof glass defect reports 0 cracks without impact (assumption) | US: Opening sunroof Offered as option (evidence) | US: Blind operation Physical button per blind; no stuck blind in endurance test (assumption)

title: Rear theatre screen usable without blocking the driver's rear view
statement: When the rear theatre screen or rear blind is deployed, the driver shall keep a full rear view (camera image in the interior mirror or on demand), and the screen shall be easy to operate and stream without cables.
rationale: Rear seat entertainment draws 34 complaint rows next to 20 likes: the lowered screen blocks the rear view and streaming often fails; 13 owners explicitly ask for a camera rear-view mirror, and rear visibility scores 5.23 vs 5.63.
horizon_rationale: Camera mirror and software fit the life-cycle impulse.
acceptance_criteria: US: Rear view with theatre screen down Camera image available in the interior mirror (assumption) | US: Study rear visibility (1-7) >= 5.6 (today 5.23, peer 5.63) (evidence)

title: Auto start-stop can be switched off permanently and restarts smoothly
statement: The driver shall be able to keep auto start-stop off across drives with one control, the engine shall not stop before the car is stationary, and the restart shall not jolt the car.
rationale: 43 complaint rows (28 usability, 13 wishes): the engine stops before standstill, restarts with a jolt and can only be avoided in sport mode; drivers describe it as unsafe at intersections.
acceptance_criteria: US: Start-stop off setting kept after ignition off Yes, per driver profile (evidence) | US: Engine stop before standstill Never (assumption)
uncertainties: Fuel economy certification may constrain a persistent off setting.

title: Easy and reliable public charging, including the Supercharger network
statement: i7 owners shall be able to charge at Tesla Superchargers, register the included charging offer without help, and plan trips around stations that are reported working.
rationale: Public charging (33 rows) and charging the battery (20 rows) complaints describe broken stations, queues, failed registration for the free charging offer and no NACS adapter.
acceptance_criteria: US: NACS access Adapter supplied at delivery (evidence) | US: Charging offer activation without dealer help >= 95 % of owners (assumption)

title: Storage for phone, sunglasses and drinks
statement: The cabin shall offer a phone place with the screen visible, a sunglasses holder, cup holders that hold different bottle sizes and more covered storage for the driver.
rationale: Storage compartments (20 rows) and front console (15 rows) complaints match the study gaps in phone storage (4.78 vs 5.47) and cup holders (4.80 vs 5.42).
horizon_rationale: Trim parts in the life-cycle impulse.
acceptance_criteria: US: Study phone storage (1-7) >= 5.4 (today 4.78, peer 5.47) (evidence) | US: Study cup holders (1-7) >= 5.4 (today 4.80, peer 5.42) (evidence)
